test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that will fill in the blank and complete the series.

(1)/(16), (1)/(4), 1, \_\_\_, 16
solution:
**Given:**

(1)/(16),(1)/(4),1 , __,16

**Calculations:**

(1)/(16),(1)/(4), 1 are in G.P 

Hence, according to the concept of GP next term will be 1 × 4 = 4

and to confirm it we can see the next term i.e., 4 × 4 = 16

**Hence, The Required value is 4**
